title: What Disease Does This Patient Have? A Large-scale Open Domain Question Answering Dataset from Medical Exams
authors_zh: Di Jin 等（MIT, Harvard Medical School）
best_for_zh: 需要补齐基础 benchmark 坐标、评测契约、contamination 和 scorer 审计的读者。
one_line: MedQA-USMLE provides 12,723 English medical licensing-exam questions, with the full MedQA release spanning 61,097 multilingual questions.
MedQA-USMLE 常用英文子集有 12,723 道医学执照考试选择题；完整 MedQA 多语 release 约 61,097 题。
why: It supplies a reusable evaluation coordinate for medical-exams, domain-expert-benchmark work.
inclusion_reason: MedQA provides medical licensing-exam questions and the 12,723-question English USMLE subset became a standard medical reasoning benchmark for LLMs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MedQA asks whether models can answer open-domain medical exam questions that require biomedical and clinical knowledge. The primary paper is arXiv:2009.13081, submitted in September 2020, with an official GitHub release at jind11/MedQA.

The collection boundary is a benchmark/evaluation surface, not a clinical decision-support system and not a source of patient-care labels. A sample is a medical exam question with multiple-choice options and an official answer; some released files also include explanations or textbook/context resources depending on subset. The feedback contract is exact-choice accuracy against the released answer key, so reuse must pin language subset, split files, prompt format, scorer, and contamination date.

MedQA 要回答的问题是：模型能否解医学考试中的开放域医学问答，尤其是需要医学知识和临床推理的选择题。主要论文是 arXiv:2009.13081，提交于 2020 年 9 月；官方代码与数据入口是 GitHub 的 jind11/MedQA。

收录边界是 benchmark/evaluation surface，不是临床决策系统，也不是可直接用于病人诊疗的标签源。一个样本是医学考试题、多个选项和官方答案；部分 release 文件还包含解释或教材/上下文资源。反馈契约是与答案 key 的精确选择题 accuracy；复用时要固定语言子集、split 文件、prompt 格式、scorer 和污染时间点。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a large medical-exam QA benchmark spanning three languages and several exam sources. The paper reports 61,097 questions in total and 12,723 English questions, including USMLE-style medical licensing questions.

The core mechanism is curation of exam-style multiple-choice questions into released train/dev/test resources, with answer-key accuracy as the feedback contract. Closest comparisons are general QA benchmarks and earlier medical QA datasets such as PubMedQA; MedQA shifts the evaluation surface toward licensing-exam reasoning. The direction label is medical-domain benchmark data, with audit risk around subset identity, split versions, licenses, and public benchmark contamination.

核心贡献是一个大规模医学考试 QA benchmark，覆盖三种语言和多个考试来源。论文报告总量为 61,097 题，其中英文题 12,723 道，包含 USMLE 风格医学执照考试题。

核心机制是把医学考试选择题整理为可发布的训练/开发/测试资源，并用答案 key 的 accuracy 作为反馈契约。最接近的是通用 QA benchmark 和 PubMedQA 等医学 QA 数据；MedQA 把评测面推向医学执照考试推理。方向标签是医学领域 benchmark 数据；复用风险集中在具体子集、split 版本、license 和公开 benchmark 污染。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: medical exam questions, answer options, official answer keys, language/source metadata, and optional textbook or explanation resources from the release.
  2. Pipeline: collect exam questions, normalize them into benchmark records, separate language/source subsets, provide split files, and evaluate model predictions by option matching.
  3. Outputs: question records with choices and gold answer labels; model evaluation outputs are accuracy scores under a chosen split.
  4. Feedback: a programmatic multiple-choice scorer compares the predicted option with the gold answer. It does not verify clinical safety or free-form medical reasoning.
  5. Reproducibility boundary: pin repository commit or release, language subset, split file, answer normalization, prompt/scaffold, and whether auxiliary textbook/context resources are used.

1. 输入：医学考试题、选项、官方答案 key、语言/来源元数据，以及 release 中可选的教材或解释资源。
  2. 流程：收集考试题，规范化为 benchmark 记录，按语言和来源划分子集，提供 split 文件，并用选项匹配评估模型输出。
  3. 输出：包含题干、选项和 gold answer 的题目记录；模型评测输出是指定 split 下的 accuracy。
  4. 反馈：程序化选择题 scorer 将预测选项与 gold answer 比对。它不验证临床安全性，也不验证自由文本医学推理过程。
  5. 复现边界：需要固定 GitHub commit/release、语言子集、split 文件、答案归一化、prompt/scaffold，以及是否使用辅助教材/上下文资源。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports 61,097 medical-exam questions across English, simplified Chinese, and traditional Chinese, with 12,723 English questions. It also reports baseline results for IR, neural, and pretrained-language-model systems; the abstract cites best accuracies of 36.7%, 42.0%, and 70.1% on the three languages.

The evidence unit is answer-key agreement for a released multiple-choice item. Aggregate accuracy supports benchmark comparison only under the same subset, split, prompt, and scorer. It is not evidence that a model's explanation is medically sound, nor that the benchmark is uncontaminated in later model training.

论文报告 MedQA 覆盖英文、简体中文和繁体中文，共 61,097 道医学考试题，其中英文题 12,723 道。摘要还报告 IR、神经模型和预训练语言模型等 baseline；三种语言上的最佳准确率分别为 36.7%、42.0% 和 70.1%。

证据单元是发布选择题与答案 key 的一致性。汇总 accuracy 只有在相同子集、split、prompt 和 scorer 下才可比较。它不能证明模型解释医学上可靠，也不能证明后续模型训练中没有 benchmark 污染。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is general open-domain QA and smaller or narrower medical QA resources. MedQA changes the object to exam-derived, multilingual medical multiple-choice questions at larger scale, with a standard answer-key scoring surface.

The direction signal is domain-specialized benchmark construction for medical reasoning rather than generic reading comprehension. The quality signal is the released question/choice/answer structure and reproducible accuracy scorer. What is not new: multiple-choice scoring and exam-question evaluation are established patterns. Before reuse, inspect copyright and redistribution terms, subset identity, split counts, official commit, and whether the target model may have seen public questions.

已有基线是通用开放域 QA，以及规模更小或覆盖更窄的医学 QA 资源。MedQA 的变化是把对象改成来自医学考试的、多语种、大规模选择题，并提供标准答案 key 评测面。

方向信号是面向医学推理的领域 benchmark 构造，而不是通用阅读理解。质量信号是发布的题干/选项/答案结构和可复现 accuracy scorer。并非全新的是选择题打分和考试题评测范式。复用前要检查版权与再分发条款、具体子集、split 数量、官方 commit，以及目标模型是否可能见过公开题。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Correctness is only answer-key correctness for exam items. The benchmark does not validate clinical deployment behavior, patient-specific reasoning, guideline freshness, or explanation fidelity.

The dataset is public, so contamination is a major risk for modern LLM evaluation. Results can change with option ordering, prompt format, chain-of-thought policy, auxiliary textbook retrieval, and split choice. Licensing and redistribution terms must be checked at the artifact level before using the records as training data or publishing derived subsets.

正确性只表示考试题 answer key 正确，不表示临床部署行为正确，也不验证病人个体化推理、指南时效性或解释忠实性。

数据公开后，现代 LLM 评测中污染风险很高。结果会受选项顺序、prompt 格式、chain-of-thought 策略、辅助教材检索和 split 选择影响。将记录用于训练或发布派生子集前，必须在 artifact 层面核验 license 与再分发条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use MedQA-USMLE as a medical-domain multiple-choice evaluation surface. Preserve question id, language/source subset, split, stem, options, gold answer, optional explanation/context fields, prompt template, model output, answer-normalization rule, and scorer version.

For atlas work, it is useful as a canonical public benchmark coordinate for medical reasoning and benchmark-contamination audits. It should be treated as evaluation data unless a separate license and provenance review supports training use.

MedQA-USMLE 可作为医学领域选择题评测面。应保留 question id、语言/来源子集、split、题干、选项、gold answer、可选解释/上下文字段、prompt 模板、模型输出、答案归一化规则和 scorer 版本。

它对 atlas 的价值是提供一个医学推理的公共 benchmark 坐标，也适合做 benchmark contamination 审计。除非另有 license 与来源核验支持，否则应按 evaluation data 处理，不应默认当作训练数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Keep the full MedQA release, the English subset, and the common USMLE evaluation use separate. Reported accuracy is answer selection, not explanation quality or clinical safety.

Read the dataset and model sections together: many downstream claims depend on whether the experiment uses only the question and options, adds textbook context, or changes prompting. Public availability makes contamination dating essential for post-2020 models.

阅读时要分清完整 MedQA release、英文子集，以及常见的 USMLE 评测用法。accuracy 是选项选择正确，不是解释质量，也不是临床安全性。

数据和模型实验部分要一起看：下游 claim 往往取决于是否只使用题干和选项、是否加入教材上下文、是否改变 prompt。由于数据公开，评估 2020 年之后的模型时必须记录污染时间线。
